chunks: Indeed, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, sees only good
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Allah sees only good?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this concise theological assertion to affirm that God’s gaze is never directed toward harm or evil, but solely toward the ultimate benefit (*maslaha*) of His creation. This statement serves as a cornerstone for Shia theological discussions on divine wisdom (*hikmah*) and benevolence (*lutf*), distinguishing God’s pure intention from human perceptions of trial or punishment.
